newsitem.title: USA: US spot LPGs edge up again, led by Belvieu propane.
newsitem.headline: US spot LPGs edge up again, led by Belvieu propane.

text.p: U.S. spot LPG prices firmed again on Tuesday, led by propane at Mont Belvieu, Texas, industry sources said.
Most products rose by about 0.25 cent a gallon from late Monday's levels, still propped up by concerns about available inventories.

Traders noted that many of the larger regional marketers put off building up inventoires during the summer in anticipation of a seasonal drop in prices. Now, with winter approaching and prices steadily climbing, they must pay a premium for stocks.
"They were slowing picking it up before," explianed one trader. "Now they need it and have to pay up."
Propane at Mont Belvieu firmed to 43.75 cents a gallon at Mont Belvieu, with some offeres heard as high as 44 cents.
Purity Ethane there rose to 29.25 cents and deals were reportedly done on E-P mix at 28.50 cents.
Most butanes were steady to narrowly higher, they said.
-- Franklin Paul, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
